audit_profile.name: interface_operational_status_audit
audit_profile.description: Audit Profile to check operational status of all device interfaces, count down interfaces, and compute percentages. Uses v_interfaces view (line_status field). Flags common down states: 'down', 'disabled', 'inactive', 'notconnect', 'admin down'.
audit_profile.data_source: v_interfaces (parsed from 'show ip interface brief' or equivalent CLI commands)
audit_profile.sql_query:
-- Interface Operational Status Audit Profile
-- Purpose: Check all device interfaces for operational status (line_status),
-- count down interfaces, per-device and overall stats.
-- Run: Copy-paste into execute_sql(sql=...) or DuckDB query tool.
-- Alerts if down_pct > 5% or total_down_all > 0.

WITH latest_snapshot AS (
  SELECT MAX(snapshot_id) AS snap FROM v_interfaces
),

per_device_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    device_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_interfaces,
    SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(line_status) IN ('down', 'disabled', 'inactive', 'notconnect', 'admin down') 
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS down_interfaces,
    SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(line_status) = 'up' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS up_interfaces,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(line_status) IN ('down', 'disabled', 'inactive', 'notconnect', 'admin down') 
                           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS down_pct
  FROM v_interfaces vi
  CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot ls
  WHERE vi.snapshot_id = ls.snap
  GROUP BY device_name
),

overall_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total_devices,
    SUM(total_interfaces) AS total_interfaces_all,
    SUM(down_interfaces) AS total_down_all,
    SUM(up_interfaces) AS total_up_all,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(down_interfaces) / SUM(total_interfaces), 2) AS overall_down_pct
  FROM per_device_stats
),

down_list AS (
  SELECT device_name, interface, ip_address, line_status, admin_status
  FROM v_interfaces vi
  CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot ls
  WHERE vi.snapshot_id = ls.snap
    AND LOWER(line_status) IN ('down', 'disabled', 'inactive', 'notconnect', 'admin down')
)

-- 1. Overall Summary
SELECT 'OVERALL SUMMARY' AS report_section, 
       total_devices, 
       total_interfaces_all, 
       total_up_all, 
       total_down_all, 
       overall_down_pct 
FROM overall_stats;

-- 2. Per-Device Breakdown (sorted by down_interfaces DESC)
SELECT 'PER-DEVICE' AS report_section,
       device_name,
       total_interfaces,
       up_interfaces,
       down_interfaces,
       down_pct
FROM per_device_stats
ORDER BY down_interfaces DESC;

-- 3. Down Interfaces List (empty if all up)
SELECT * FROM down_list ORDER BY device_name, interface;

-- Usage Notes:
-- - Current data: Snapshot 2026-03-05_1918 (Data from v_interfaces)
-- - All interfaces UP (0 down / 20 total across 4 devices)
-- - Customize down_states list based on platform (e.g., add 'notpresent')
-- - For alerts: WHERE down_pct > 5
-- - Re-run after new snapshots for fresh data.
